description: A single-image table (the caption designates it Table II); there are no micrographs, spectra or plots, only text cells. The table has seven bold underlined column headers — Alloy, Process, Grain size (μm), Hardness (HV), UTS (MPa), YS (MPa), EL total (%) — and five data rows, each giving a mean with ± one standard deviation where applicable. The rows read: Fe-7Al / AIM (190 μm, 193 ± 7.9 HV, 472 ± 5.4 MPa UTS, 428 ± 6.5 MPa YS, 8 ± 1.4% EL); Fe-7Al / AIMFC (195 μm, 198 ± 9.1 HV, 467 ± 5.7 MPa, 396 ± 8.1 MPa, 18 ± 1.6%); Fe-7Al / VIM (186 μm, 188 ± 7.8 HV, 445 ± 5.6 MPa, 360 ± 7.5 MPa, 20 ± 2.1%); Fe-9Al / AIMFC (228 μm, 263 ± 8.9 HV, 349 ± 6.3 MPa, 318 ± 8.0 MPa, 0.1 ± 0.1%); Fe-9Al / VIM (218 μm, 250 ± 9.8 HV, 568 ± 7.0 MPa, 517 ± 9.0 MPa, elongation printed as "09 ± 2.16"). The table's argument: within Fe-7Al, going AIM → AIMFC → VIM lowers strength but raises total elongation (8 → 18 → 20%), while Fe-9Al AIMFC is hard and almost completely brittle (0.1% EL) and Fe-9Al VIM is the strongest alloy tabulated; no Fe-9Al AIM row exists, matching the caption's statement that its gas porosity prevented testing.

observations.observation: The image is a single table whose seven column headers are Alloy, Process, Grain size (μm), Hardness (HV), UTS (MPa), YS (MPa) and EL total (%).
Five data rows are present: Fe-7Al with AIM, Fe-7Al with AIMFC, Fe-7Al with VIM, Fe-9Al with AIMFC, and Fe-9Al with VIM; there is no Fe-9Al + AIM row.
For Fe-7Al the process sequence AIM → AIMFC → VIM gives decreasing yield strength (428 ± 6.5, 396 ± 8.1, 360 ± 7.5 MPa) but increasing total elongation (8 ± 1.4, 18 ± 1.6, 20 ± 2.1 %).
Fe-9Al + VIM has the highest UTS (568 ± 7.0 MPa) and YS (517 ± 9.0 MPa) of any row in the table.
Fe-9Al + AIMFC combines the highest hardness (263 ± 8.9 HV) with a nearly zero total elongation of 0.1 ± 0.1 %.
Grain sizes listed span 186 μm (Fe-7Al VIM) to 228 μm (Fe-9Al AIMFC), i.e. the Fe-9Al rows have the coarser grain size.
The EL total cell of the Fe-9Al + VIM row is printed as '09 ± 2.16', which is apparently a typographical error and most plausibly means 9 ± 2.16 %.
The caption states the table reports room-temperature properties of hot-rolled Fe-7 and 9 Al alloys processed by AIM, AIMFC and VIM.
The caption states that the Fe-9Al alloy ingot produced by AIM exhibited a large amount of gas porosity, so tests were not carried out — explaining the absent Fe-9Al + AIM row.
No individual data points, error-bar sources or test standard are given in the table image; only tabulated means with standard deviations appear.
